description: This artifact prepares a permission-only replay package; it is not execution, scoring, endpoint validation, or cosmological validation.
Candidate and controls must use the same symbolic statistic, same row scope, same q_i weights, same signs, and same standardization rule.
Control designs are carried forward as frozen requirements; they are not executable scoring controls in this package.
The covariance route remains caveated block diagonal; no source-native cross-probe covariance product is claimed.
A later executable replay requires a separate run-template/execution authorization gate.
